technique_name: Please describe the difference between micro and macro-evolution.
description: Microevolution refers to small-scale changes in the genetic makeup of a species over time. This type of evolution can be observed and happens over a relatively short period of time. Macroevolution, on the other hand, refers to large-scale changes in the genetic makeup of a species over time. This type of evolution generally happens over a much longer time-span and is primarily observed through fossil records.
